basic_info.description: Located in the heart of iconic Russian Hill, this irresistible residence captures the very soul of San Francisco living. Surrounded by iconic architecture, and breathtaking views, you're just moments from candlelit dinners, hidden cafes, boutiques, and the timeless rhythm of the city. Create gourmet meals in the updated kitchen, equipped with designer appliances, including a Bertazzoni range, quartz countertops, and ample cabinets. Enjoy the convenience of a dedicated laundry nook, adjacent to the kitchen. An entertainer's dream, the spacious dining room invites slow, joyful gatherings, flowing into the sun-kissed living room, where bay windows frame unforgettable views of the Golden Gate Bridge and shimmering Bay. Retreat in the spacious bedroom, which offers romantic vistas and generous storage with both a walk-in and additional closet. Refinished hardwood floors throughout, soaring ceilings, and elegant crown molding add warmth, while the updated bathroom completes the home with style and ease. Enclosed one-car parking with EV charging capacity completes the picture. Property includes co-ownership of 1341 Union Unit #1. New owner to receive $249.90 monthly from rent.
